title: Nepal PAN Registration Certificate
description: Fields from the compact PAN certificate format shown in rajendra_rai_pan.png.

pan_no.description: Permanent Account Number from the ten individual cells. Preserve displayed order; use ASCII digits when clear.

inland_revenue_office.description: Inland Revenue Office name in the first office row.

taxpayer_service_office.description: Taxpayer Service Office name in the second office row.

income_tax_registration_date_bs.description: Income-tax registration date in the right-hand day/month/year cells. Extract as YYYY/MM/DD BS when present.

vat_registration_date_bs.description: VAT registration date in the second right-hand day/month/year row. Extract as YYYY/MM/DD BS; empty when blank.

excise_registration_date_bs.description: Excise registration date in the third right-hand day/month/year row. Extract as YYYY/MM/DD BS; empty when blank.

taxpayer_name.description: Individual taxpayer name from the row labelled taxpayer name.

business_name.description: Registered business or firm name from the row labelled business name.

taxpayer_type.description: Taxpayer category or legal type from the taxpayer type row.

address.description: Full taxpayer address, preserving line breaks when shown.

business_activities.description: Business activities from the long bordered row immediately above signatures.
